name: Portland Golf Club
centre_source: course centroid from opengolfapi.org and stymie.golf (apparently the OSM polygon's centre); clubhouse 45.477540, -122.762366 from the NRHP nomination; the course reaches ~820 m S, ~370 m N, ~300 m E of the clubhouse
architects: Dan Hixson (restoration from ~2013; bunkers, greens, tees 2022)
renovations: 1925: Fanno Creek diverted out of the 16th (club site)
~2013: ~75 trees removed, 20+ around the 13th green (Hixson master plan)
2022 (Mar-Nov): bunkers 63 -> 51 (15 moved), 12 greens enlarged, 15th green rebuilt, tees regraded, forward tees on ~10 holes (Dan Hixson, shaper Tony Russell)
video_games: none known (Wikipedia lists none; a dedicated search was not possible, the shared search budget ran out)
